name: Dicentra
source:
"I've landed myself right in the mouth of a carnivorous flower with the sweetness of shelter to lure me in."

Dicentra is a gothic horror visual novel.

You play as Basil, a young boy lost in a forest of watchful trees and unfriendly guides. In a harsh storm, his only sanctuary is a seemingly abandoned mansion.  Only once the doors have locked behind him, does he learn that this place is haunted by more than just ghosts.

[From [url=https://safffeine.itch.io/dicentra]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我已经落入一朵食肉花的嘴里，用庇护所的甜蜜来引诱我。”

Dicentra是一部哥特式恐怖视觉小说。

你扮演巴兹尔，一个迷失在警惕的树木和不友好的向导的森林中的小男孩。在狂风暴雨中，他唯一的庇护所是一座看似废弃的宅邸。只有当门在他身后锁上时，他才知道这个地方不仅仅有鬼魂出没。

[来自[url=https://safffeine.itch.io/dicentra]itch.io[/url]]
